text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, how wonderful...! This vivid red, it truly is a food befitting a saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(No! What does that matter?
These are the sacred red noodles born for the Saint—
I must partake of them myself...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, so spicy... No, this too is a trial.
I must endure... *slurp*... Spicy...

By the time she somehow finished the super spicy ramen,
Red Desire was completely worn out.
